digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方开源的 Agent 技能库，为 AI 智能体提供可复用的标准化能力模块

repos.summary_zh: 让 AI Agent 流式输出布局数据，应用用 React、Flutter 等原生组件直接渲染的生成式 UI 框架

papers.title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
papers.abstract: Hybrid architectures have become mainstream among open-weight language models. Their global-attention and bounded-state layers maintain heterogeneous caches whose demands vary with context length and
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向混合架构大模型的透明缓存管理与逐层流式调度系统，在CPU-GPU超芯片上统一管理异构缓存并动态调度，显著提升长上下文高并发场景的吞吐效率

papers.title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
papers.abstract: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy
papers.summary_zh: 提出用预言机教师蒸馏训练主动特征获取策略的新方法，在多个数据集上以更低采集成本达到更优预测精度

papers.title: Realized versus Population Reliability: Anytime-Valid Self-Consistency Certification under Correlated Reasoning
papers.abstract: Self-consistency certification treats repeated sampling from a language model as sequential evidence accumulation and stops when an anytime-valid e-process crosses a threshold, guaranteeing finite-sam

papers.summary_zh: 提出PlayCraft框架用视觉智能体试玩驱动游戏迭代设计，自动生成更具精通乐趣的可玩游戏

papers.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, exi
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向前沿智能体直接机器人控制的细粒度评估框架AgentRoboCritic，突破仅看回合成功率的局限，揭示其底层动作生成能力与失败模式

papers.title: SoK: Assessing the Evolution of LLM Capability in Software Vulnerability Research
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents are becoming increasingly capable at discovering, validating and patching vulnerabilities in real software, and vendors and researchers report that this is already changing how vulner
papers.summary_zh: 系统梳理LLM在漏洞发现验证修复中的能力演进，提出统一评估框架并揭示厂商报告与学术研究间的能力差距

papers.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering

papers.title: Variants of Beam Search for DiskANN

papers.title: Represented but misread: Post-training changes how language models read out what they represent
papers.abstract: Does post-training change what a language model represents, or how this representation is read out into an answer? We compared linear probes with the models' own answers, analyzed with signal detectio
